title: Step by Step Guide to Importing Excel Data into Business Central
summary: This post demonstrates how to import Excel data into Business Central by creating a staging table, using the Excel Buffer record to read spreadsheet contents, validating the data, and then creating actual business records. It covers practical steps for handling external Excel files with custom logic and error checking.
key_points: Use a temporary staging table to import and validate Excel data before creating actual records
Leverage the Excel Buffer record and File Management codeunit to read Excel files and parse cell values
Implement validation procedures to check data integrity, such as verifying unit of measures and item types
Parse Excel cell values as text first, then convert to appropriate data types using Evaluate
Display validation messages to users so they can correct errors before generating final records

quotes.text: We are going to start by defining a staging table that we can import the data into.
quotes.why_it_matters: Staging tables provide a safe intermediate step to validate and process external data before committing to actual records.
